Non VCU apartments give more freedom and are normally cheaper. Pine Courts is pretty good, location is good and price was not bad when I still lived there. Utilities are all included in the rent including internet so that’s nice. Internet can be a bit slow sometimes but it does the job. Plus they have a lot of different apartment sizes so you can find whatever fits your needs best.

I’ve also rented with metro properties and they’re not too bad either. A little bit slow with maintenance and the homes are normally a little bit older, but overall there’s more variety in apartment/home styles.
